Interface CausalProducer<K,V>

Type Parameters:
K - the record key type
V - the record value type
All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface CausalProducer<K,V> extends AutoCloseable
A Kafka producer that attaches a causal dependencies header to every record it sends.

Each send(ProducerRecord) call embeds the serialised CausalDependencies as a parsley-causal-dependencies header. Downstream causal consumers and processors use this header to determine whether a record's causal dependencies have been satisfied.

Usage

Prefer stamping the dependencies of the message that triggered this send — bounded by that hop's fan-in and transitively carrying its own dependencies: 
CausalProducer<String, String> producer = CausalProducers.<String, String>builder(producerConfig).build();
CausalDependencies context = CausalDependencies.fromRecord(trigger).orElseGet(consumer::frontier);
producer.send(new ProducerRecord<>("orders", key, value), context);
Pass consumer.frontier() only when the produced record genuinely depends on everything the consumer has read (e.g. an aggregator): the serialised size is proportional to the number of relevant topic-partitions and counts against Kafka's record-size limit (message.max.bytes), so a wide-fan-in frontier can grow large — see CausalDependencies for the size envelope.

Thread safety

A CausalProducer is thread-safe and a single instance can be shared across threads, like the KafkaProducer it wraps. send(ProducerRecord) builds a fresh record carrying the dependencies header and never mutates the ProducerRecord passed in, so the caller's record may be reused.

  • Method Details

    • send

      default Future<org.apache.kafka.clients.producer.RecordMetadata> send(org.apache.kafka.clients.producer.ProducerRecord<K,V> record)
      Sends a record with no causal dependencies — a positive assertion that this record does not depend on any prior record. Stamps an empty parsley-causal-dependencies header.

      Use this when the record is genuinely independent. To declare a dependency on prior work, use send(ProducerRecord, CausalDependencies) instead.

      Parameters:
      record - the record to send; must not be null
      Returns:
      a Future for the RecordMetadata of the sent record
